items.source: Create a new instance of the Location class.
items.translation: 创建一个新的Location类实例。

items.source: resource - the resource with which this location is associated

Typically used to track the location of problematic or erroneous metadata in XML configuration files. For example, a source location might be 'The bean defined on line 76 of beans.properties has an invalid Class'; another source might be the actual DOM Element from a parsed XML Document; or the source object might simply be null.
items.translation: 通常用于跟踪 XML 配置文件中有问题或错误的元数据的位置。例如，`source` 位置可能是“beans.properties 第 76 行定义的 bean 具有无效的 Class"；另一个来源可能是从解析的 XML `Document` 中获取的实际 DOM 元素；或者源对象可能简单地就是 `null`。

items.source: See the class level javadoc for this class for examples of what the actual type of the returned object may be.
items.translation: 请参阅此类的类级别 Javadoc 示例，以了解返回对象的实际类型可能是什么。

items.source: Get the actual location within the associated resource (may be null).
items.translation: 获取关联的resource中的实际位置（可能为null）。

items.source: Get the resource with which this location is associated.
items.translation: 获取与此位置关联的资源。

items.source: source - the actual location within the associated resource (may be null)
items.translation: source - 关联资源中的实际位置（可能为 null）
